verdict.rationale: The only evidence that Mastra consumes external MCP servers' tools is a community report that Stdio MCP servers were supported while SSE servers were not, requiring a proxy workaround. The first-party docs here cover authoring MCP servers and MCP events, which is the server and event side rather than plugging servers in as tools. missing for 10: first-party docs on an MCP client or tool-loading API, remote (SSE/HTTP) transport support, hands-on confirmation that agents call the imported MCP tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: A user noted that only Stdio MCP servers were supported, not SSE MCP servers.
